limitations: CUDA peaks are saved allocated-memory peaks, not a job-wide external GPU monitor.
Smoke and current selection/actual modification fractions are distinguished.
No new metric computation, experiment or Val-rep tuning was performed.
The saved manifest fingerprint is from each final evaluation report; training configs record the cache path, not a per-run startup fingerprint.
resources_scope: wall_seconds is the local SGE accounting ru_wallclock; CUDA peaks are maximum saved training/final-evaluation allocated peaks. No host maxvmem is presented as GPU memory.
numerical_scope: Official saved aggregate scores are copied; L/LB, arithmetic contrasts and sample standard deviations (ddof=1) are computed from them. No masks, metric geometry or Counts are recomputed. Markdown values are rounded from this JSON.
